summary: A code screenshot tool as one static page: paste code, Shiki highlights it, frame it with padding, corners, shadow and a background, export a sharp PNG or SVG, copy to clipboard in Safari and Chromium alike, and share a snap by URL with no server.

stack.choice: One HTML file, vanilla JS, Canvas 2D

prerequisites.name: A terminal and a code editor
prerequisites.why: Every step below is a command you type or a file you edit.
prerequisites.get: VS Code (code.visualstudio.com), Cursor or Zed. Open a folder for the project and use the editor's built-in terminal.
prerequisites.verify: You can open a folder and run a command in its terminal

prerequisites.name: Git
prerequisites.why: History for your code, and the way most hosts deploy.
prerequisites.get: Install from git-scm.com or with your package manager, then run git init in the project folder once it exists.

prerequisites.name: A Chromium browser and Safari
prerequisites.why: Clipboard image copy differs; Phase 3 tests both.
prerequisites.get: Chrome or Edge plus Safari on a Mac.

prerequisites.name: A static host (optional)
prerequisites.get: Cloudflare Pages, Netlify or GitHub Pages.

phases.title: Highlight
phases.goal: Textarea in, highlighted code out, live.

steps.do: Create index.html loading Shiki from a pinned ES module CDN or a vendored bundle
steps.detail: Vendor it into the repo so the page works offline later.

steps.do: A language selector, a theme selector and a debounced re-render

check: JavaScript, Python and JSON highlight correctly

phases.title: The frame
phases.goal: Padding, radius, shadow, window chrome, line numbers, ten backgrounds, one render().

steps.do: One state object and one render function drawing to the canvas

check: Every control updates within a frame
The preview matches what will export

phases.title: Export
phases.goal: PNG at 1x and 2x, SVG, and clipboard in both engines.

steps.do: Offscreen canvas at the target scale for PNG; an SVG serializer
ClipboardItem with a Promise-of-Blob inside the click handler
steps.detail: Safari requires the promise form; Chromium accepts it.

check: 2x is exactly twice the pixels and sharp
SVG opens in a vector editor
Paste works in Safari and Chromium

phases.title: Share by URL
phases.goal: Code and settings compressed into the hash.

steps.do: Encode state with CompressionStream into the URL fragment
Restore from the fragment on load

check: A shared link restores code, language, theme and frame exactly

phases.title: Polish

steps.do: Keyboard shortcuts and localStorage settings in try/catch
Verify zero network requests after load with Shiki vendored

check: A first-time user knows what to do

phases.title: Ship it as an app
phases.goal: Installable and offline with a privacy line.

steps.do: Manifest and a service worker caching the files
Deploy on a custom domain with the nothing-is-uploaded note

check: Installs as an app and opens offline

product.outcome: A code image tool that is private by construction and shareable by URL.

notIncluded: Animated transitions between code states and video export: the paid product, and hard.
after: A VS Code extension that opens the page with the selection
